_real_world.variant_scope: Type 093B (Shang-III) SSN. Also used as the Type 093A bow sonar (no distinct bow-array data reported for 093A vs 093B).
hulls: Type 093B (Shang-III) hull numbers not individually public
public_equipment: bow-mounted sonar array, designation not public (improved over Type 093A per ONI/USNI, no model number)

_provenance.modeling_note: The OOB and ONI/USNI sourcing (A/B-tier) confirm Type 093B carries an improved bow sonar suite over the original Type 093/093A, but no designation or detection-range figure is public for either variant. Modeled as a modern SSN bow sonar following the repo's SSN Virginia-class bow sonar module convention (active/passive, large-aperture), scaled down slightly given the absence of PLAN-specific performance data. Reused for Type 093A per this packet's decision to write 093A as a distinct hull/loadout record (no VLS) but without inventing a separate, undifferentiated bow-sonar figure for it.

sonar.mode.note: modeled as active/passive per the repo's SSN bow-sonar convention; no PLAN source states passive-only operation for the bow array specifically (the boat's overall quieting is a separate, unmodeled characteristic)

sonar.max_range_m.note: no public detection-range figure; engineering estimate for a modern large-aperture SSN bow sonar, scaled below the repo's US Virginia-class module given the absence of PLAN-specific sourcing

sonar.scan_period_s.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo's SSN bow sonar module convention

sonar.range_noise_std_m.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo's SSN bow sonar module convention

sonar.directivity_gain_db.note: no public figure; engineering estimate for a large-aperture bow array, higher than the packet's surface-combatant bow sonar module

sonar.self_noise_per_speed_db.note: no public figure; carried close to the repo's SSN bow sonar module convention

modeling_notes: Reused for both Type 093A and Type 093B bow sonar per this packet's decision to differentiate the two hulls by VLS/weapon loadout rather than by an unsourced bow-sonar performance delta; no ONI/USNI source distinguishes 093A's bow array performance from 093B's.
